results.releaseNotes:
NEW IN 7.0:

DUST RUNNERS

A new game in the iPhone app. Haul relief cargo across Ossan Flats on a hover speeder: keep right, dodge the haulers, hop the rocks and get the crates there on time.

- 20 runs: a day shift, then the night shift, ending at Scrapjaw's yard
- Three speeders: the RUSTBUCKET, the fast SIDEWINDER and the MULE hauler
- Raiders come for your crates. Throw DUST to blind them, BOOST to get clear
- Knocks cost condition, so clean driving pays. Credits buy upgrades in the GARAGE
- Three stars on every run

ONE GAMES KEY

FLY on the iPhone console is now a single GAMES key. Both games live behind it: Dust Runners and the pilot training simulator, which has a new home page with a picture for every mission and your next one up front.

Stars and progress you already have are kept.


NEW IN 6.1:

MISSIONS REMIXED

Missions 4 to 20 of the pilot training simulator now each have their own sky and their own twist. Missions 1 to 3 are unchanged, and any stars you've already earned are kept.

• Asteroid fields to fly through, and to duck behind.
• Defend a relay station, take on a fixed gun platform, and strike a carrier with six gun nodes.
• Raiders that come at you out of the sun's glare.
• An enemy ace who takes ten hits to bring down.
• Channel runs with layouts you can learn, faster doors, the lights out, and flame vents to time.
• New skies: dust, ice, ember, nebulae, a gas giant and a ringed world.


NEW IN 6.0:

PILOT TRAINING SIMULATOR

Tap FLY on the iPhone console and take the controls. Twenty short missions, a few minutes each: dogfights, convoy escorts, carrier strikes and low runs down a narrow service channel.

• Earn up to three stars on every mission: finish it, keep your shields up, and beat the mission's own challenge. Replay any mission for the stars you missed.
• Win a mission to open the next one in its line. The last two levels open with stars.
• The cockpit's targeting computer is the ANq 3.6 from this app, tracking and locking on to your target.
• Lasers, homing torpedoes, and power you shift between lasers, shields and engines.
• Your wingman calls out contacts by clock position on the cockpit's radio screen, and warns you when someone's on your tail.
• Left thumb steers, right thumb fires.

TIMERS ON APPLE WATCH
Long-press the face for SYSTEMS and set MODE to TIMER. Turn the crown to set the time, then tap the clock to start. Each unit keeps its own countdown, with a tap on your wrist at zero.

ALSO
• Timers now step one second at a time under a minute and one minute at a time above, so any number of minutes works.
• ANq 3.6 on Apple Watch now fills in as you close your rings, like it does on iPhone.
• ANq 3.6 has a KEY page on iPhone and Apple Watch showing which band is which ring.
results.description:
Some pilots, at the critical moment, switch off their targeting computer and go with their gut. Yours now tells the time — so maybe leave it on.

A wireframe tunnel. Red range lines closing in. A crosshair that locks on and holds. Stay On Target turns your Apple Watch into a 1970s vector targeting display, with the time underneath in a big angular red readout. It is, technically, a clock.

Spin the crown and the radio crackles — short pilot callouts, recorded for this app.

Tap the date and your week scrolls away into the distance as a text crawl: today, tomorrow, and every day after that with something on it. Drag it with a finger or spin the crown to move through at your own pace. Nothing booked? It says so, and it sounds pleased for you.

FOUR UNITS

- ANq 3.6 — the tunnel: receding frames and rays, a twelve-second loop of range sweep, lock-on and chevrons. Amber or phosphor green.
- T-s7b — the range grid: two gridded gates swinging through space, gold on crimson, a ship marker between them, contacts curving past. The gates fill with your rings.
- DS-1 — the orbital approach: a red planet edge to edge, a green moon coming out from behind it as your Move ring fills, stars lighting with Exercise, a reticle filling with Stand. Close everything and it locks on.
- YV-4 — the base tracker: the war room's plotting table. A planet dead centre, a tracker coming round it with a flashing red cone of sight that eats into the green as your Move ring fills, until it lands on your moon. Stand lights the rim scale, Exercise grows the moon.

Long-press for SYSTEMS to switch units. KEY shows what each readout means.

ON IPHONE TOO

The iPhone app is the console the display is mounted in: each unit on its own screen shape, with the date, clock, ring bars and your next appointment around it. Turn it sideways for the full console, or press FULL and keep only the display. The Mission Briefing crawl plays across the whole screen. One purchase covers both.

TWO GAMES

Tap GAMES on the iPhone console. Both are included.

Dust Runners: haul relief cargo across a desert world on a hover speeder. Twenty runs over a day shift and a night shift. Keep right, dodge the haulers, hop the rocks, blind raiders with dust and deliver on time. Three speeders, a garage of upgrades, three stars on every run.

Pilot training simulator: take the controls. Twenty short missions: dogfights, convoy escorts, carrier strikes and low runs down a narrow channel, each with its own sky and its own twist. Earn up to three stars on every mission, replay for the ones you missed, and open the next. The cockpit's targeting computer is the ANq 3.6 from this app.

WHAT IT DOES

- Always-on display: the clock keeps time while the animation rests
- Amber or phosphor green on the tunnel — tap to switch cockpits
- Radio callouts on the crown — every unit has its own, and two of them read the dial to you — silenced with one tap when you're in a meeting and your wrist starts talking
- Mission Briefing: your week's appointments as a receding crawl — drag or spin to scrub through it
- Rings, steps, resting heart rate and last night's sleep, read straight off the watch
- Countdown timers on the watch: turn the crown to set, tap the clock to start
- 12 or 24 hour, whichever way you were trained
- The watch app runs on its own; the iPhone app is optional. No account, no setup
- Collects nothing. We genuinely have no idea who you are

Tip: Settings → General → Return to Clock → 1 hour. Now it stays up like a real watch face every time you raise your wrist.

Don't get cocky.

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
